scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.production:config: npm run production:env && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile tunnel config --quiet
scripts.production:start: npm run production:env && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile tunnel up -d --build --wait
scripts.production:down: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile tunnel down
scripts.production:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile tunnel logs -f
